notes.title: IndiePlay Awards ceremony and Trading Cards release on November 13!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697700/Whos_Lila/
[h1]Hello everybody![/h1]

I'm glad to announce that [b]Who's Lila?[/b] has become finalist in the [b]IndiePlay competition[/b] - Chinese indie Game Awards that has successfully been held for 7 years and, according to their website, the most powerful indie game award event in China. The event is organized by CiGA (China indie Game Alliance)，supported by indienova, IGDA, UGDAP and many medias and international associations!

In honor of that [b]Who's Lila?[/b] will be participating in a Sale from [b]07.11 to 14.11[/b]; but here's even more exciting news - as the final awards ceremony will be held on [b]November 13[/b], the long-awaited [b]trading cards[/b] will be released on the same date! 

[h2]So stay tuned, I have prepared some awesome assets for you all![/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40949357/e7c47f8cbd631fbd6b8d3b547e09d35942e17480.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE, Indiecup and other news
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DZ3fVK3zqWk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Who's Lila? is coming out February 23.[/h1]

Hey everyone! Sorry for the delay,
Who's Lila is ready content-wise, the debug phase is also near its end.

[h2]The game will feature:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 15 endings
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Unlockable palettes
[*] 50 + music tracks
[*] [i]arg elements[/i]
[*] and more!
[/list]

The Demo Saves are not going to be compatible with the final game, unfortunately.

[h1]Who's Lila? will be entering IndieCup, Winter Season 2022![/h1]
[b]IndieCup[/b] is the largest indie games competition in Eastern Europe - if you are an Eastern-European dev, I recommend you check it out! The application period closes in mid-February, so you still have time.

Link: [url=https://indiecup.net]https://indiecup.net[/url]

[h3]Next up:[/h3]
10. Feb - Trailer release + new Itch.io page

Stay tuned!
